note: Family-run RV and mobile-home park on U.S. 41 near White Springs, ~1 mile from the Suwannee River (no on-site frontage), easy I-10/I-75 access. 20 acres of oversized sites, many paved. Heated pool, propane, clubhouse; cabins and tent sites too. A personal vehicle is required to stay. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site: 72 RV sites with 30/50-amp, water and sewer, 28 pull-throughs, hot showers, 24-hour laundry, free Wi-Fi; daily $40 plus tax (fees left; the page carries no date). Added site count and booking (form + phone, card on file). Not stated: season. Note: dropped the hookup, price and laundry/WiFi text; added the personal-vehicle requirement.
flags: Long-stay signals for a human (AWH five-test rule): the operator calls it 'Kelly's RV/MH Park', 'governed by Florida Statute Chapter 513 and 723', with 20 mobile homes, monthly RV rent ($346.50 + electric), late-rent eviction rules and 'Owner reserves the right of approval or disapproval of all renters'; 'A personal vehicle is mandatory to be accepted'. It does post a $40 daily rate 'perfect for those passing through' and RV sites outnumber homes 72 to 20, so it likely passes, but the approval clause touches test 2.
